name: fastcrud-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is FastCRUD (`fastcrud`), a Python library for FastAPI that provides async CRUD
methods over SQLAlchemy 2.0 models with Pydantic schemas (filtering with operator suffixes, sorting, offset and
cursor pagination, joins and nested results, soft delete, upserts) and generates CRUD endpoints with `crud_router`
and `EndpointCreator`.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is every Python module under fastcrud/ except those under fastcrud/examples/. The documentation in scope is README.md, these pages under docs/: index.md, usage/overview.md, usage/crud.md, usage/endpoint.md, advanced/overview.md, advanced/crud.md, advanced/dependency_filtering.md, advanced/endpoint.md, advanced/filters.md, advanced/joins.md, advanced/response_keys.md, api/overview.md, api/crud_router.md, api/endpoint_creator.md, api/fastcrud.md and api/paginated.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples. In-package code comments are only supporting
evidence; when they conflict with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 w
